image_description: A close-up, low-angle shot of a vintage, heavily rusted cast-iron sad iron (flatiron) resting on a textured purple fabric surface. The iron features a solid, looped handle integrated into the top plate and a thick, wedge-shaped body with a scalloped decorative edge near the top. The surface is pitted and corroded, indicating age and lack of modern non-stick coatings. No power cord or modern controls are visible.
